name_input: BSL SCAFFOLDING LIMITED; BSL SCAFFOLDING LIMITED; BSL SCAFFOLDING LTD; BRITISH SCAFFOLDING (INDIA) LTD.; BSL SCAFFOLDING LIMITED; M/S BSL SCAFFOLDING LTD; M/S BSL SCAFFOLDING LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/bsl-scaffolding-limited) shows 80 total shipment records, 3 trading partners, 6 ports, latest cargo 2025-08-07. Exact rows seen (5 of 80 displayed): "2025-03-29 | BSL SCAFFOLDING LIMITED | ESTIM CONSTRUCTION CO. LTD. | BSL SCAFFOLDING MATERIALS-STEEL SHUTTERING PLATE 1500 X 600 X 70MM | NoidaDadriICD, India -> Tanzania | 73084000 | BOL 9499754"; also "2025-03-19 ... Tanzania ... 73084000 | BOL 9135707", "2025-03-06 ... Tanzania ... 73084000 | BOL 8777974", "2025-08-07 ... PUERTO CORTS, Honduras ... 76109010 | BOL 2885425", "2025-02-18 ... Chittagong, Bangladesh ... 86090000 | BOL 8272932". Source counter: page header states Total Shipments 80; rows actually visible to me = 5 (paywall truncation). Declared HS 730840 matches the observed export HS 73084000 on three Tanzania shipments.
domestic_evidence: No domestic supply record obtained. GeM/CPPP tender search and GST turnover lookup could not be completed: web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) and thecompanycheck/tofler pages returned HTTP 403/404. Company website https://www.bslscaffolding.com/ returned only a bot-verification interstitial ("One moment, please... Loader Please wait while your request is being verified..."), no content. GST turnover band: null (not public in retrieved sources). Note: ImportKey also lists BSL SCAFFOLDING LTD. (Plot No. 103 & 104, Sector 7, SIDCUL, Haridwar) as an importer of aluminium profiles from Changsha Xiangjia Metal Material Trading Co. (5 rows seen, BOLs SHUR31B0H200, SHUR94302600, SHUR21302300, SHUR95302900, SHUR54302600) — inbound raw material, not domestic supply.
note: Export activity is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs records with B/L numbers and destinations (Tanzania, Bangladesh, Honduras), including three 73084000 steel shuttering plate shipments to ESTIM CONSTRUCTION CO. LTD. in Tanzania in Feb–Mar 2025 — so the declared HS 730840 is the actual dominant export code and no correction is needed. Domestic supply side is unverified: no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP contract or annual-report split could be retrieved within the tool budget, so domestic_status is unknown rather than none_found — absence of evidence here is a research gap, not a finding of no domestic sales. Two distinct addresses appear in the data (D-10 Neb Valley, Neb Sarai, Mehrauli, New Delhi 110068 and Plot 103-104, Sector 7, SIDCUL, Haridwar), consistent with a Delhi trading/registered office plus a Haridwar manufacturing unit; the Haridwar entity is recorded as an importer of aluminium profiles, which supports a real manufacturing operation rather than a pure trader. No CIN, PAN or revenue figure is asserted — none was publicly retrievable in the sources read.
